# RISE & AI Sweden Public MCP

> A public, no-auth MCP server indexing AI-relevant publications from RISE and AI Sweden, Sweden's two government-funded AI organizations. Provided in good faith to support the agentic AI ecosystem.

Run by Joakim Jardenberg (joakim@jardenberg.com) and Lovable.

## MCP endpoint

- URL: https://rise-ai-sweden.jardenberg.org/api/mcp
- Transport: streamable-http
- Auth: none
- Suggested client name: `rise-ai-sweden`

## Tools

- `search_swedish_ai` — Hybrid semantic + lexical search across RISE and AI Sweden publications (sv/en). Vector arm for topical queries; lexical arm (tsvector with Swedish/English stemming, trigram fallback) for proper nouns and short keyword queries. Reciprocal-rank-fusion merge; lexical arm weighted 2x when query ≤2 tokens. Filters: `source`, `lang`, `page_type`, `limit` (1–50, default 20).
- `find_mentions` — Lexical "everything that mentions X" primitive. Stemmed tsquery + exact-substring fallback, with a `total` field that reconciles with `count(DISTINCT id) WHERE raw_markdown ILIKE '%term%'`. Filters: `source`, `lang`, `page_type`, `limit` (1–100, default 25).
- `list_latest` — Newest indexed documents; lightweight metadata only. Filters: `source`, `lang`, `page_type`, `limit` (1–50, default 20).
- `find_similar` — Given an indexed URL, return semantically nearest documents.
- `get_document` — Full cleaned markdown for a single indexed URL.
- `list_sources` — Sources covered, document counts, language breakdown, last-updated.

## Page types

Every document is labeled with a URL-derived `page_type`:

- `event` — events / past events
- `news` — news posts and announcements
- `project` — project, sector-initiative, and program pages
- `page` — anything else

Relevance filtering is the client's job; our job is labeling.

## Freshness

Both sitemaps are re-checked automatically every day at 04:15 UTC; new and changed pages are scraped, cleaned, chunked, and embedded in the same pass. `list_sources` reports the live per-source last-fetch timestamp.

## URL handling

URL inputs to `get_document` and `find_similar` (and URL-shaped `find_mentions` terms) are canonicalized before lookup: https scheme, canonical host (`www.ai.se`), no fragment, no tracking params, no trailing slash. Bare-host and query-decorated variants resolve to the same document.

Event pages on ai.se that 301-redirect off-domain (Invajo, Meetup, etc.) are deliberately not indexed.

## Signed responses (provenance trust layer) — spec org.jardenberg.verifiable-mcp/0.2

Every `tools/call` response (and JSON-RPC error) is signed and carries a provenance block. Additive only — all existing data fields are unchanged.

- `result._meta["org.jardenberg.verifiable-mcp"]` = `{ spec: "0.2", alg: "EdDSA", kid, signed: "wrapper", iat, payload_digest, jws }`.
- Signed scope: a wrapper `{ iat, payload, provenance }` where `payload` is the tool result data (no provenance mirrored inside it).
- Canonicalization: **RFC 8785 (JCS)**, normative for the JWS payload and every digest.
- `payload_digest` = `sha256:<hex>` over the RFC 8785 canonical `payload`.
- Content binding: `content[0].text` is exactly the RFC 8785 canonical serialization of `payload`.
- `provenance`: `server_operator` ("Studio Jardenberg"), `server`, `content_publisher` ("RISE" / "AI Sweden"), `canonical_origin` (https://www.ri.se / https://www.ai.se), `legal_basis` ("EU TDM exception (DSM art. 3-4); all content remains © its publisher"), `content_hash` (SHA-256), `dataset_version`, `last_updated`.
- Key discovery: https://rise-ai-sweden.jardenberg.org/.well-known/mcp.json (server card + `jwks`), or the dedicated JWK at https://rise-ai-sweden.jardenberg.org/.well-known/rise-ai-sweden-mcp-public-key.json (`kid` = RFC 7638 thumbprint, alg EdDSA/Ed25519).
- Deprecated (removed in v0.3): the v0.1 sibling `result.signature` over `structuredContent`, and the `provenance` mirror inside `structuredContent`, are still emitted so existing clients keep working.
- If the signing key is unavailable, responses are served unsigned; signing never blocks a query.
- No MCP client verifies these signatures automatically yet — this is a working pilot of verifiable MCP responses.

## Rate limit

60 requests / 5 minutes per IP.

## Sources

Live document counts, language breakdown, and last-updated timestamps are available via the `list_sources` MCP tool.

## Citation

Every result returned by the MCP includes the original publisher URL on ri.se or ai.se. Agents should cite and link those, not this MCP server.
